info.title: ScreenConnect Gateway
info.description: Single REST API over ConnectWise ScreenConnect's built-in web API and the RESTful API Manager extension. All reads are GET. Responses carry `X-Gateway-Backend: restful|native`. Errors are always `{"message": "..."}`.

get.description: Probe both backends with a cheap read. Results are cached briefly.
Distinct companies (Custom Property 1). Use `id` (raw, untrimmed) for lookups.

Native SecurityService.SaveUser: create (oldUserName null), update, or rename (newUserName differs).
Updates replace every field, so they must be stated explicitly; a null password keeps the current one.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Raw company ids that match case- and whitespace-insensitively

group.title: Group
group.description: Native fallback: single session group name (same as groupPath=[group])

id.title: Id
id.description: Raw Custom Property 1 value, exactly as stored (not trimmed). Use this for lookups.

customProperties.description: Any of the 8 properties by index ("0"-"7"). A named field (company/site/department/deviceType) and its index may both be given only with the same value; different values are rejected (400).

passwordQuestion.title: Passwordquestion
passwordQuestion.description: SaveUser passwordQuestion argument, which ScreenConnect uses for the user's MFA/OTP setting: "email", "<provider>:<value>", or null for none. Alias: otpTokenString.

customProperties.description: Any of the 8 properties by index ("0"-"7"). A named field (company/site/department/deviceType) and its index may both be given only with the same value; different values are rejected (400).

IndexedCustomProperties.title: IndexedCustomProperties
IndexedCustomProperties.description: Custom properties by zero-based index ("0" = Custom Property 1 ... "7" = Custom Property 8).

receivedAt.title: Receivedat
receivedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Native times in the payload are relative (seconds/ms before this or BaseTime)

omittedFields.title: Omittedfields
omittedFields.description: Object keys removed at every depth because they are agent credentials (GuestPublicKey, WakeToken, ClientMachineCookie). Nothing else is removed.

RawResponse.title: RawResponse
RawResponse.description: Upstream payload, verbatim, with source metadata.

oldUserName.title: Oldusername
oldUserName.description: Existing user to update/rename (originalUserName). Null creates a new user.

newUserName.title: Newusername
newUserName.description: Resulting user name (a different value renames)

password.title: Password
password.description: Null keeps the existing password (updates only)

verifyPassword.title: Verifypassword
verifyPassword.description: Defaults to password; must match it if given

passwordQuestion.title: Passwordquestion
passwordQuestion.description: SaveUser passwordQuestion argument, which ScreenConnect uses for the user's MFA/OTP setting: "email", "<provider>:<value>", or null for none. Alias: otpTokenString.

SaveUserRequest.title: SaveUserRequest
SaveUserRequest.description: Mirrors SecurityService.SaveUser. oldUserName null creates a user; set it to update or rename one.

oldUserName.title: Oldusername
oldUserName.description: Set when an existing user was updated or renamed

loggedOnUsers.title: Loggedonusers
loggedOnUsers.description: All signed-in users (e.g. several on a terminal server)

isOnline.title: Isonline
isOnline.description: Agent connected (an active guest connection). Null only if the upstream omits connection data.

guestMachineSerialNumber.title: Guestmachineserialnumber
guestMachineSerialNumber.description: Restful: GuestInfo.MachineSerialNumber. Native: get_session/details only (null in lists).

guestHardwareNetworkAddress.title: Guesthardwarenetworkaddress
guestHardwareNetworkAddress.description: MAC address. Restful: GuestInfo.HardwareNetworkAddress. Native: get_session/details only.

guestInfoUpdateTime.title: Guestinfoupdatetime
guestInfoUpdateTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC. When the agent last reported guest info. Native: get_session/details only.

lastGuestConnectedEventTime.title: Lastguestconnectedeventtime
lastGuestConnectedEventTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Restful only; native has no guest-only equivalent (null).

lastGuestDisconnectedEventTime.title: Lastguestdisconnectedeventtime
lastGuestDisconnectedEventTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Both backends (native is derived from relative seconds, ±2 s).

eventType.title: Eventtype
eventType.description: SC.types.SessionEventType, e.g. 44 QueuedCommand, 70 RanCommand (command output), 32 AddedNote

time.title: Time
time.description: ISO-8601 (native times are converted from ms before BaseTime)

eventType.title: Eventtype
eventType.description: SC.types.SessionEventType name or number, e.g. QueuedCommand / 44
